reason: UITron-Speech directly consumes speech instructions in an end-to-end GUI agent and adds a training-free two-step grounding refinement. Full text is needed to separate the trained speech/GUI backbone from the inference-only correction path and to resolve datasets and local fit.

CAFA closes an acoustic/user-feedback loop into real-time hearing-aid tuning commands under an LLM judge. It is a direct speech/audio control application whose training boundary, data, and safety gate need page-level resolution.

The paper evaluates a training-free dysarthria-severity measure over frozen speech representations across 3,374 speakers, 25 datasets, and six backbones. It can provide an acoustic reward/measurement instrument and requires dataset-level local-fit review.

DAS is a training-free sequential-Monte-Carlo controller for reward-aligned test-time sampling that explicitly addresses reward over-optimization, diversity, multi-objective control, and online black-box optimization.
DebUnc converts uncertainty estimates into attention or prompt weights during multi-agent inference, providing an open confidence-aware aggregation and communication comparator.
Chain of Mindset is an explicitly training-free router that selects cognitive modes step by step and gates information between modules, a close analogue for runtime policy and routing control.

MemQ performs runtime temporal-difference credit propagation over a provenance DAG of retrieved memories. It is an open bridge between reward-guided control, online agent memory, and knowledge provenance.
FOREAGENT predicts candidate quality before expensive execution and then verifies selected candidates, directly informing execution-budget allocation and selective evaluation.

A-MapReduce supplies task-adaptive parallel decomposition, aggregation, experiential allocation, and measured cost reduction for wide search; it also directly informs the survey and future falsifier-search execution model.

PlugMem organizes compact propositional and prescriptive knowledge rather than raw trajectories and is evaluated unchanged across heterogeneous agent tasks, making it a direct executable-knowledge-base reference.
RVLM uses a no-fine-tuning generate-execute loop plus a controller that allocates adaptive reasoning depth and terminates stalled trajectories, directly relevant to budget and stopping policy design.

AgentProp-Bench measures judge-human agreement, error propagation, rejection versus recovery, and a runtime interceptor. It is open falsifier evidence for verifier reliability and deployment-dependent mitigation.
Repo2Run iteratively builds containers and tests repositories from build feedback, providing an open environment-construction reference for the next reproduction-first phase.

One-Eval turns natural-language evaluation requests into traceable benchmark, dataset, metric, and reporting workflows with human checkpoints and rollback, closely matching the required experiment knowledge layer.
PaperBench contributes author-validated hierarchical replication rubrics, judge evaluation, and open scaffolding, a useful reference for specifying and scoring reproduction tasks.
Pi-Serini isolates retrieval depth and lexical-search configuration inside an agentic evidence loop, giving an open baseline for the planned literature knowledge base and surfaced-evidence recall.
MemSyco-Bench tests when retrieved memory should be rejected, scoped, reconciled with evidence, updated, or used, providing a direct falsifier suite for a memory-backed research knowledge base.

The benchmark isolates procedural-memory retrieval and documents a cross-context generalization cliff, which can guide how experiment recipes are represented and retrieved rather than stored as unordered text.
MemLens contrasts long-context and memory-agent failure modes on genuinely multimodal multi-session evidence, especially storage-time compression and visual-fidelity loss.
CoPS selects cross-task experiences with a pessimism-based distribution-match rule, supplying an open mechanism and theoretical boundary for reusing prior experimental traces under shift.

HiRED is a plug-and-play attention-guided token-budget allocator with measured latency and memory savings, providing an independent comparator for transferring saliency-based budget control to acoustic tokens.

ThetaEvolve explicitly updates model checkpoints through reinforcement learning at test time. Its open system is a useful boundary comparator for distinguishing inference-only control from test-time training.
